title: WPSS/1068/2011 of MOHAN LAL SHARMA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. (S/S) 1068 of 2011
Mohan Lal Sharma ÖPetitioner
Versus

State of Uttarakhand and others Ö.Respondents
Present : Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.

Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. Heard Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the petitioner
and Mr. N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel for the State of
Uttarakhand.
2. The petitioner is presently challenging the order
dated 30.7.2011 by which the earlier
promotion/adjustment given to the petitioner was
cancelled.
3. Counter affidavit and rejoinder affidavit have been
exchanged, and the pleadings are complete. All the same,
during the pendency of the writ petition, it is an admitted
case that the said order dated 30.7.2011 was stayed by
the Secretary, Rural Development, Dehradun vide order
dated 12.9.2011 holding that the order dated 30.7.2011
was passed in violation of Article 311 of the Constitution
of India.
4. Since it is an admitted case of the respondents that
the impugned order dated 30.7.2011 was passed in
violation of principle of natural justice and fair play, it
would meet the ends of justice if the said order be
quashed. Impugned order dated 30.7.2011 is therefore
quashed. Writ petition is allowed though liberty is given
to the respondents to pass fresh orders in accordance
with law, after compliance of principle of natural justice

2
and fair play. Needful be done within a period of three
months from today. It is further directed that the
petitioner shall cooperate in the proceedings. In case the
petitioner does not cooperate, the respondents shall be at
liberty to proceed ex parte against the petitioner.
5. With the observations made above, writ petition is
disposed of.
6. No order as to costs.
(Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
17.11.2011
Avneet
